metrics.name: exact_match
metrics.description: 1.0 if the output equals the expected output after normalization (NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse, surrounding punctuation stripped), else 0.0.

metrics.name: latency
metrics.description: Wall-clock time of the successful model call in milliseconds, measured by the engine around the adapter call (final attempt only; retries are not included).

metrics.name: estimated_cost
metrics.description: Estimated cost of the successful model call: provider-reported input and output tokens times the per-million-token prices in the run's pricing table. Not billing data. Not applicable when usage is not reported or the model has no price.
